en.p: The sequence $\{a_n\}$ is a geometric sequence, and for every natural number $n$ the sequence $\{b_n\}$ is defined by
The sequence $\{b_n\}$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) The series $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_{2n-1}$ converges and its sum is $-3$.
(B) The series $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_{2n}$ converges and its sum is $8$.
